annotations.title: Are people talking about this online, and is it spiking?

description: Use when the user is listening for discussion of a brand, product, launch or category among technical and early-adopter audiences: "is anyone talking about our launch?", "did this topic spike this month?". Returns weekly mentions on Hacker News and Bluesky, spike weeks, and the Hacker News stories that drew the most points and comments. Not Reddit or X. Bluesky is counted only, never quoted. Refuses before you are charged if nothing matches. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: built in: by week over days; segment: platform (Hacker News, Bluesky). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For news coverage, use run_news_pulse; to compare names, use run_social_share_of_voice.
